claims.scope_caveat: Four runs, two per revision; the incident is expected to end FAILED (cause fence_result) and each did. Each seal was a metadata-only patch to the real shippingservice Deployment: metadata.generation went 138 to 139 and 151 to 152 at 0a8d4d7, and 177 to 178 and 180 to 181 at be6e636, with no template write, and the operator restore after each run raised it once more. The paused Executor's conditional patch was refused (CONFLICT) and the write watcher counted 0 writes after release.
